situations.title: Ukraine-Russia Attrition Phase
situations.summary: Frontlines remain static but high-intensity. Strategic focus has shifted to deep-strike drone warfare against energy grids and logistical hubs within Russian territory. NATO supply consistency remains the primary Ukrainian pivot point.

situations.title: Israel-Hezbollah Border Conflict
situations.summary: IDF operations have expanded into a tactical buffer zone in Southern Lebanon. Hezbollah retaliates with high-frequency precision missile barrages targeting Haifa and Tel Aviv. Diplomatic de-escalation efforts currently yield no results.

situations.title: South China Sea Maritime Stand-off
situations.summary: Repeated collisions near Second Thomas Shoal. China's 'gray zone' tactics now include permanent blockade maneuvers, testing the US-Philippines Mutual Defense Treaty. US naval presence in the sector is at a five-year high.

situations.title: Sudan Internal Collapse
situations.summary: Famine conditions affect 60% of the population. Port Sudan remains the last functional hub as the RSF consolidates control over agricultural heartlands. International humanitarian access is systematically blocked by combatants.

situations.title: Myanmar Resistance Expansion
situations.summary: Junta control is restricted to major urban centers as resistance forces seize key border crossings. Signal of state fragmentation; signals thin on a unified post-junta governance transition.

situations.title: Red Sea Shipping Disruption
situations.summary: Houthi forces utilize advanced Iranian-origin underwater drones. Global maritime insurance premiums remain prohibitive, forcing 70% of East-West transit via the Cape of Good Hope, impacting European inflation targets.

situations.title: Sahel Insurgency Surge
situations.summary: Jihadist groups expand influence toward coastal West African states. Military juntas struggle to maintain security despite Russian mercenary support. Civilian casualties from counter-insurgency operations are rising sharply.

ticker: LEVANT TENSIONS: Israel expands Southern Lebanon buffer zone; Houthi underwater drones freeze Red Sea commercial transit.
